methodology: Statuses assigned from non-destructive HTTP probes and public docs review. ACTIVE requires a working connector returning real records in this repo. Prefer free public APIs/RSS/feeds over paid aggregator APIs when both exist. No scraping of ToS-protected / paywalled / login sites. No invented credentials success.
